purpose: Teach: 生き残る/内陸/空襲/徹し/元素/王室/画一/誇張

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、重い病から、本気で、絶対、生き残る患者さん、本当に、勇気、ある方々ですね、絶対、感謝、しております、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Ren, I have to say — the patients who survive serious illnesses, the ones who really do make it through… they have such genuine courage. I'm genuinely grateful to them, truly.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful opening. Warm recognition in the voice. A slight pause before acknowledging courage. Measured pace. Voice carries earned respect without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 内陸の地方、本気で、医療アクセス、絶対、課題ですね、先生、本気で、本当に、感謝、しております、医療、続けて、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Healthcare access in remote areas — it's still such a real challenge, isn't it, Doctor? I'm genuinely thankful for practitioners who keep working out there, truly.
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching tone. Leans into the question with genuine curiosity. Not performing understanding but reaching for it. Steady eye contact level. Ends with sincere gratitude.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。戦時、空襲下の医療、本気で、絶対、医師、貢献、本当に、立派でした、本気で、本当に、感謝、しております、絶対、本気、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. During wartime, the doctors treating patients under air raids… they were truly remarkable. Their dedication was real. I'm deeply grateful for what they gave.
lines.style: Measured and even. Brief pause before 'wartime' — weight of historical acknowledgment. Quiet conviction. No rush. The respect of someone who has studied this carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療研究、本気で、絶対、徹した先生方、本当に、立派ですね、絶対、感謝、しております、本気で、本当に、頭が下がります、絶対、本気で、本当。
lines.en: The researchers who devoted themselves to medical advancement with such commitment… they deserve real admiration. I'm genuinely humbled by their work.
lines.style: Genuine reverence. Slower pace — each phrase considered. Slight intake of breath before 'humbled.' Not performative; the honest reflection of someone in the same field aware of the sacrifice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬の元素分析、本気で、絶対、進歩、しております、本気で、医療界、本当に、活気、感じます、絶対、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. And the progress in new drug analysis has been real — I can feel the energy and momentum in medicine right now. It's something to be grateful for.
lines.style: Brighter than before but still grounded. Slight lift in energy when discussing progress. Clear, informative tone without becoming clinical. Warm recognition of forward movement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 王室、本気で、絶対、医療研究、絶対、支援している話、ニュースで、見ました、本気で、本当に、嬉しい、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: I saw in the news that the royal family is supporting medical research initiatives. That's genuinely encouraging to see.
lines.style: Soft enthusiasm. Recognition without overselling. A small smile in the voice. The tone of someone noting something quietly positive. Genuine warmth but not exuberant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療、本気で、画一化、絶対、避けるべきですね、患者さん、本気で、お一人、絶対、お一人、違いますからね、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. Healthcare shouldn't be one-size-fits-all — each patient is different, you know? We have to honor that. I'm grateful for practitioners who remember that.
lines.style: Firm but kind conviction. Light emphasis on 'different' — the small word that matters most. Steady, professorial but not distant. Voice of someone who has seen what happens when individuality is lost.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療情報の誇張、本気で、絶対、社会的に、絶対、問題ですよね、先生、本気で、正しい情報、必要、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The way medical information gets exaggerated in society — that's become a real problem, hasn't it? We need better, more accurate information. That's something I'm grateful for when I find it.
lines.style: Earnest concern beneath the surface. Thoughtful pace. Not alarmist, but genuinely troubled by the gap between truth and noise. Ends with quiet determination to find and share better information.
